title: Seeing Is Not Enough: Knowledge-Grounded Active Inquiry from Uncertain Visual Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.38774v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Similar tongue findings can accompany different syndromes in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), with decisive symptoms absent from the photograph. We present a framework for tongue assessment in which image and pulse findings guide targeted symptom inquiry and acquired answers refine the syndrome shortlist before reporting. Image/pulse predictions guide selection from a sourced symptom question bank. Known answers update the assessment used to select the next question. A calibrated loss of support for the initial prediction triggers reassessment; a subsequent report requires fresh answers supporting a stable candidate. Question and answer records make these decisions inspectable. We construct 2,600 cases from distinct real tongue photographs, assigned syndromes, simulated symptom responses and rendered pulses; 2,599 enter five-fold source-disjoint evaluation and one is training-only. translated_title: 看见尚且不够：基于知识的、针对不确定视觉证据的主动问询
translated_abstract: 在中医（TCM）中，相似的舌象可能伴随不同的证候，而决定性的症状并不出现在照片中。我们提出了一个舌诊评估框架，其中图像与脉象的判读结果指导有针对性的症状问询，所获得的答案在最终报告前细化证候候选列表。图像/脉象预测指导从有来源依据的症状问题库中选择问题；已知的答案会更新用于选择下一个问题的评估。当初始预测的支持度经校准后出现下降时，将触发重新评估；随后的报告需要新的答案来支持一个稳定的候选证候。问答记录使这些决策可被查验。我们从不同的真实舌象照片构建了2,600个案例，并配以指定的证候、模拟的症状回答和渲染的脉象；其中2,599个用于五折来源不相交评估，1个仅用于训练。在干净图像上，仅凭图像/脉象预测即可达……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个中医舌诊框架：当舌象与脉象证据不足以区分证候时，系统依据校准后的支持度下降触发主动症状问询，并利用问答动态更新证候候选列表，使整个判断过程可追溯、更可靠。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a TCM tongue-diagnosis framework in which calibrated loss of support for uncertain visual evidence triggers active symptom inquiry, iteratively refining the syndrome shortlist with inspectable question-answer records for more reliable diagnosis.
